picture.opening: Scene 1 shows the subject of the first sentence from frame 0, already moving: the figure mid-action in its situation, or the object it is dealing with. Never a title card or an empty page.
picture.turn: A new scene starts on the first word of a turn or a re-opening, and its picture is visibly different from the scene before (a new image, the diagram's next state, a new place). Never merge that segment into the scene before it.
picture.payoff: The payoff scene gets the video's strongest picture: the hero image, the largest element, the diagram fully built.
picture.ending: Hold on the payoff picture to the last frame. No closing card, logo, recap or sign-off after it.

best_for: mechanisms: how a thing works, processes, architecture, data flow
walkthroughs with generic roles (the user, an attacker)
avoid_for: stories that need recurring, recognisable characters
signals: the beats are animation-led diagrams and line art
people in the script are roles, not named individuals
